title: Miami nightlife this week: GTA lottery, Doja Cat, and the cold front
igCaption:
Miami has a ticket lottery, an arena show, a day party, and hoodie weather this week.

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami, RESIDENT™, Secret Miami

#Miami #MiamiNightlife #SouthFlorida #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: The Grand Theft Auto VI festival lottery closes today, and Miami still has a few nights worth planning around.

First, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival lands Saturday, November 21, at Mana Wynwood. Rockstar and PlayStation announced two stages, with Travis Scott, Cardi B, Justice, Metro Boomin, Tainy, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, and Rauw Alejandro & Friends.
scenes.caption: First, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival lands Saturday, Nov. 21, at Mana Wynwood. Rockstar and PlayStation announced 2 stages, with Travis Scott, Cardi B, Justice, Metro Boomin, Tainy, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, and Rauw Alejandro & Friends.

scenes.text: The ticket setup matters. Fans had to enter the lottery by 4 p.m. Tuesday, November 10. Selected entries get an SMS code by 7 p.m., then the sale opens at noon Wednesday. The festival is for guests 17 and older.

scenes.text: Wednesday night, Doja Cat brings the Ma Vie World Tour to Kaseya Center on Biscayne Boulevard. Latto opens. The show starts at 7:30, and tickets were listed from $39 to $159. If you're there, check NEAR and see who else was at Kaseya.

scenes.text: For the weekend crowd, Delilah Miami has Sundays on the Water as a weekly waterfront day party. Friday night drops near 59 degrees, Saturday reaches about 73, and Sunday warms near 77.
